solutionCriteria: Meal plan includes caloric surplus appropriate for lean mass gain (approximately 300-500 kcal above maintenance)

All meals are realistic, practical, and achievable for a single athlete without specialized ingredients

scenario: Testing with a tall, lightweight endurance athlete (e.g., 185cm, 68kg) with a muscle-building goal and no dietary restrictions - verifies the prompt calculates appropriate caloric surplus and macronutrient distribution for lean mass gain

solutionCriteria: Meal plan includes exactly 1 day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

taskDescription: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
